# cmake/CMakeLists.txt -- AUTO-GENERATED by `tur fetch`. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SpiceDeps)

include(FetchContent)

option(TUR_FETCH_FORCE_FETCH "Bypass system find_package for :prefer-system deps" OFF)

# sndfile
FetchContent_Declare(sndfile
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/libsndfile/libsndfile
  GIT_TAG        1.2.2
)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(sndfile)
set(_sndfile_resolved_via "fetch" CACHE INTERNAL "")

# --- Generate spice-deps-manifest.json ---
set(_spice_manifest_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/spice-deps-manifest.json")
set(_spice_manifest "{\n")
set(_spice_first TRUE)

# manifest entry: sndfile
if(NOT _spice_first)
  string(APPEND _spice_manifest ",\n")
endif()
set(_spice_first FALSE)
FetchContent_GetProperties(sndfile)
if(EXISTS "${sndfile_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
  set(_spice_sndfile_inc "${sndfile_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
else()
  set(_spice_sndfile_inc "${sndfile_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(_spice_sndfile_bld "${sndfile_BINARY_DIR}")
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "  \"sndfile\": {\n"
  "    \"resolved_via\": \"${_sndfile_resolved_via}\",\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"${_spice_sndfile_inc}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"${_spice_sndfile_bld}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"sndfile\"]\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest "  }")

string(APPEND _spice_manifest "\n}\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_spice_manifest_path}" CONTENT "${_spice_manifest}")
message(STATUS "spice: will write cmake/spice-deps-manifest.json at generate time")
